name: Skills Tree
description: Branching skill tree that unlocks nodes with earned skill points, gated by level requirements. A run that crosses between regions tears the whole build down and rebuilds it, so anything a player earned has to be handed to the next build through a DECLARED input or it is silently lost — which is how an RPG hands back a fresh character every time you walk off the edge of the map. That is what the initial-state input below is for: it is the same rule economy.currency's startingBalance follows, and it is a request's business to supply, never this component's to remember.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: initialUnlocked
inputs.description: Node ids already unlocked when the build starts. Prerequisites are NOT re-checked against this list: it is a restore, not a purchase, and re-validating it would let a tree edited between sessions silently delete a player's build.

inputs.name: initialPoints
inputs.description: Unspent points at the start. Null means the tree's own starting allowance, which is what a fresh character gets.
